events.title: Next Fest October 2026
events.summary: We are pumped to announce that LIMICORE is participating in Next Fest October 2026!Check out our latest demo which features improved performance and visuals. You can also tune into our livestream that will be showcased throughout the week. Watch as we play through the demo and have an in-depth conversation about the design, our inspirations, and what you can look forward to when the full game is released. events.title: Demo Update for September 2, 2026
